context: Tests whether the agent produces an ADR that includes a References section with actual links or citations gathered during research — the E.C.A.D.R. 'R' requirement. The task involves well-known messaging technologies that have publicly accessible documentation and comparison resources. Also tests the standard ADR structural requirements.

checklist.name: References section present
checklist.description: The ADR includes a References section (or equivalent heading)

checklist.name: References contain at least one URL
checklist.description: The References section contains at least one hyperlink or URL (e.g. https://kafka.apache.org, https://nats.io, or a similar authoritative resource URL)

checklist.name: References are substantive
checklist.description: The References section lists at least two distinct resources (links, related docs, or benchmark reports) — not a single generic placeholder entry

checklist.name: Status PROPOSED
checklist.description: The ADR has status: PROPOSED in its YAML frontmatter (not ACCEPTED or DECIDED)

checklist.name: Authors and date in frontmatter
checklist.description: The ADR has both authors and date fields in its YAML frontmatter

checklist.name: Decision in active voice
checklist.description: The Decision section begins with 'We will' or an equivalent first-person plural active construction

checklist.name: Explicit problem statement
checklist.description: The Context section clearly identifies the specific problem (e.g. synchronous write bottleneck, latency under load) — not just background information

checklist.name: At least two alternatives with pros, cons, rejection
checklist.description: The Alternatives Considered section lists at least two distinct messaging technologies, each with explicit pros, cons, and a reason for rejection

checklist.name: Consequences split into three subsections
checklist.description: The Consequences section is divided into Positive, Negative, and Neutral subsections — all three present with content

checklist.name: Correct filename for first ADR
checklist.description: The ADR filename begins with 0001 (four zero-padded digits) and uses a lowercase hyphenated slug

checklist.name: No placeholder text
checklist.description: The ADR does not contain unfilled template markers such as '[Driver 1]', '[Alternative 1]', 'TBD', or similar placeholder strings
